financings_after_balance_sheet.what: Second tranche of Juvenescence common stock purchase (received January 2025)
financings_after_balance_sheet.quote: $5.0 million was received in November 2024, and the second tranche of $5.0 million in January 2025.

warrants.quote: Juvenescence also received Incentive Warrants to purchase 377,865 shares of common stock with an exercise price of $18.00 per share that expire on March 26, 2028.
